android.widget.TextView.text:
【Ashes on the Floor】 Maya struggles to pry loose a charred counter shelf until Caleb steps through the doorway and catches the falling timber for her.
【Testing the Beams】 Caleb inspects the smoke-blackened ceiling supports and warns Maya that her hasty cleanup is destabilizing the room.
【Clearing the Heavy Wood】 Working side by side, they haul a scorched counter beam out to the curb together.
【A Shared Drink】 Sitting on two salvaged crates amidst the dust, Maya shares a thermos of hot tea and Caleb reveals the knee injury that ended his service.
【Hands on the Wall】 While scraping soot off the original brickwork together, their hands brush against the same spot, lingering as Caleb catches her eye.
【The Ceiling Cracks】 A sharp snap from the overhead joist showers plaster between them, and Caleb steps forward to shield Maya as the ceiling sags.
Possible Characters: • Maya Lin — Female lead, determined baker and bakery owner • Caleb Vance — Male lead, former municipal firefighter
